Zitterman then chimed in to say that "this is a technology that we've been building on since Diablo 3" and that "when the time is right, we can deep dive a little bit more on exactly how some of the technology allows us to solve that problem." As such, it sounds like we'll learn a lot more about how Diablo 5's procedural generation works before the game launches in 2029.
